title: Attention Is All You Need: The Scaling Factor

beats.text: Why do GPUs sit idle during LLM inference until Attention Is All You Need unlocks 98.2% throughput?
beats.visual_focus: A plot showing softmax gradient vanishing as dimension d_k increases.

visual_blueprint.title: SOFTMAX GRADIENT COLLAPSE
visual_blueprint.sub: Visualization of gradient saturation in high-dim space

motif_params.title: SOFTMAX GRADIENT COLLAPSE
motif_params.sub: Visualization of gradient saturation in high-dim space

beats.text: The bottleneck arises because the dot product of two random vectors with high dimensionality grows significantly in magnitude, pushing inputs into extremes.
beats.visual_focus: Vectors expanding outward in a multi-dimensional space, showing magnitude growth.

visual_blueprint.title: VECTOR EXPANSION
visual_blueprint.sub: Growth of dot product values as dimensions increase

motif_params.title: VECTOR EXPANSION
motif_params.sub: Growth of dot product values as dimensions increase

beats.text: The eureka pivot is the scaled dot-product: we simply divide the raw attention score by the square root of the dimension.
beats.visual_focus: The division operator scaling down the weight matrix.

visual_blueprint.title: ATTENTION IS ALL Y ARCHITECTURE
visual_blueprint.sub: The division operator scaling down the weight matrix.

params.sub: The division operator scaling down the weight matrix.

motif_params.title: ATTENTION IS ALL Y ARCHITECTURE

motif_params.caption: Modalnet-32

beats.text: This mechanism keeps the variance of the product at unity, preventing the softmax from becoming a one-hot vector and keeping gradients alive.
beats.visual_focus: A Gaussian distribution centered at unity being preserved after scaling.

visual_blueprint.title: KERNEL CODE: ATTENTION IS ALL Y
visual_blueprint.sub: A Gaussian distribution centered at unity being preserved after s

beats.text: Empirically, this shift allows models to train stably at high dimensionality, achieving 41.8 BLEU scores on translation tasks while remaining parallelizable.
